newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR STARTS TUESDAY MIXED ON KEY UNITS.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR STARTS TUESDAY MIXED ON KEY UNITS.

text.p: The Zimbabwe dollar was quoted mixed against hard currencies at the quiet start of Tuesday interbank trade and dealers predicted an eventless day with little exchange rate movement.
"The market is fairly quiet this morning. We don't expect the Zimbabwe dollar to move much today. It should range between 11.2800 and 11.3050 (against the key U.S. unit)," one dealer commented.

At around 0720 GMT, the Zimbabwe dollar was trading at 11.2850/2950 on the U.S. currency, a slight gain over Monday's 11.2950/3050 close and was also firmer at 6.6750/6795 against the mark compared to 6.6815/6830.
It was however quoted weaker on sterling at 18.5880/6160 versus 18.5095/5390 and eased a notch against South Africa's rand to 2.5295/5307 from 2.5290/5305.
